title: Database runtime identity App Env policy and UEACP same-cycle binding

phases.objective: Make deployed App Env the only runtime source of truth for database/schema identity, remove operator-entered UEACP target schemas, verify the live DB identity against App Env in the same read-only cycle, and enforce a repository-wide PR ratchet against future database identity literals, fallbacks, or manual workflow overrides.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository contributor and governed UEACP evidence operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Pull request validation plus the trusted-main UEACP live source-capture contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Runtime, governance, and persistence database identities remain bound to DB_NAME, GOVERNANCE_DB_NAME, and RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_NAME respectively; repository policy rejects hardcoded or manually overridden identities; UEACP derives TARGET_SCHEMA from Hostinger App Env DB_NAME and accepts census evidence only when DATABASE() matches it in the same cycle.
steps: Run the database runtime identity policy regression suite against safe and intentionally unsafe synthetic files.
Verify non-empty literal fallbacks for canonical database identity environment variables are rejected.
Verify concrete Hostinger-style database literals and static TARGET_SCHEMA assignments are rejected in runtime/workflow zones.
Verify workflow input bindings cannot override TARGET_SCHEMA or canonical database identity variables.
Verify the UEACP live source-capture workflow has no target_schema input and reads DB_NAME from the deployed Hostinger App Env through the authenticated env control surface.
Verify TARGET_SCHEMA is created only from that same-cycle App Env readback and is bound into the short-lived read-only authorization.
Verify the live census requires TARGET_SCHEMA and rejects DATABASE() or same-cycle readback identity mismatches.
Keep governance and persistence identity roles separate from runtime DB_NAME and leave all provider/database mutation disabled.
assertions: The canonical role mapping is runtime=DB_NAME, governance=GOVERNANCE_DB_NAME, persistence=RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_NAME.
No actual deployed database/schema value is encoded in the policy contract or UEACP workflow.
A missing, malformed, masked, or mismatched App Env database identity fails closed.
The UEACP workflow cannot accept an operator-entered target_schema value.
The live census proves DATABASE() equals the App Env-derived TARGET_SCHEMA before source evidence can advance.
The policy runs on every pull request to main regardless of changed path.
Documentation, migrations, tests, and synthetic fixtures may be non-blocking evidence zones, while runtime/workflow findings block.
No Production deployment, migration Apply, SQL mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, runtime authority change, or external write is performed by this E2E journey.
